anf_compare.notes: No public-domain English of On Pascha exists (Toura 1941; Daly ACW 54 and Witte's German are copyrighted and were not copied). Sense checked against the locked Witte Greek (and, for 1.94, Victor of Capua's Latin as Witte prints it) and the wording of the cited scriptures.

apparatus: Book I subscription. Then β opens Book II.

bible_refs.note: Quoted: he who spares the staff hates his son; he who loves disciplines carefully.

pass_a_gloss: For the one sparing his staff hates his own son, but the one loving disciplines carefully, we have read in the Proverbs.
pass_b_english: For the one who spares his staff hates his own son, but the one who loves disciplines carefully — we have read in Proverbs (Proverbs 13:24).
source_text: ὁ φειδόμενος γὰρ τῆς βακτηρίας αὐτοῦ μισ[εῖ τ]ὸν ἑαυτοῦ υἱὸν, ὁ δὲ ἀγαπ[ῶ]ν ἐπιμελῶς παιδεύει, ἐν τοῖς Παρ[οιμ]ίαις ἀνέγνωμεν. Ὠ(ριγένους) [πε]ρὶ πάσχα ᾱ
